mechanism: Bumetanide may deplete CoQ10 levels through inhibition of mitochondrial HMG-CoA reductase pathway, and loop diuretics cause electrolyte depletion that impairs CoQ10-dependent mitochondrial function and cardiac energy metabolism.
action: Monitor patients on chronic bumetanide therapy for signs of muscle weakness or cardiac dysfunction; CoQ10 supplementation may be considered to mitigate statin-like depletion effects and support cardiac function in heart failure patients.
